title: NILS grants and detail
description: Record 25, with record 42 R7 in version 3: models:see and models:work, the model registry, and campaigns:see and campaigns:work, reading a campaign, and claiming, answering and closing its items, since a rater is not a reviewer of the whole queue; no ladder set but admin holds the campaign grants. Record 48, D1 of the move: sealed:see reads what a system said of a stack of a sample sealed now (the rules' values, System 1's, a decision, a review item, a suggestion); every other caller is answered as if the stack held none. No ladder set holds it, admin's neither, and the everything set leaves it out, so only a token or a binding that names it gives it: the certificate's computation runs under one, and no person holds it while they read. What a person may open, as grants, and how much of a record they see, as detail. The desk's tokens carry both as the grants and detail claims. A grant names a page and how far a person goes there: see, or work, which includes see; the assistant has use. Detail is ordered, lowest first. The ladder's four names and assist stand for the sets in vectors/grants.json wherever they are still met.

detail.description: plain: neither class; quasi: the quasi-identifying class (sex and age) and the viewer's pixels; sensitive: the sensitive class, raw identifiers and burned-in annotation

step.description: A ladder name, as a ceiling or a binding still names it; it stands for its set

grants.description: The token's grants claim: plain strings. A reader drops a string it does not know.
